Wildlife Photographer of the Year 2026 Winners Announced

The winners of the Wildlife Photographer of the Year 2026 competition have been announced, featuring striking images. Among the winning entries are photographs of an urban coyote and an elephant carrying a dead calf. A total of 19 winning images were selected.
